objective.label: Streaming
objective.description: Calibrated for Spotify/Apple/YouTube loudness normalization (-14.0 LUFS / -1.0 dBTP ceiling).

workingWell: Clean headroom margin (True Peak -4.36 dBTP, 0 clipped samples).
Balanced crest factor (13.5 dB) and dynamic range (14.2 dB).

findings.title: Naturally Bass-Heavy Foundation (Clean Midrange Separation)
findings.explanation: Low-frequency weight sits cleanly below the 150–400 Hz mud region without masking vocal/snare midrange articulation. Avoid unnecessary bass attenuation.

findings.title: Baseline Integrated Loudness & Headroom Observation
findings.explanation: Measured baseline loudness is -15.9 LUFS at -17.9 dBFS RMS.

recommendations.proposedCorrection: Shape tonal contour surgically while clearing subsonic rumble below 28 Hz.
recommendations.proposedParamsSummary: MINIMUM phase · Tilt +0 dB · 3 band(s) · Flat 24 dB/oct high-pass @ 28 Hz for measured rumble (16-30 Hz is 3.0 dB vs 60-250 Hz (rumble above -8 dB)) · Baxandall high shelf +1.1 dB @ 8 kHz (slope -4.23 dB/oct)

commands.name: Master Contour EQ
commands.rationale: Calibrate subsonic headroom and broad tonal balance from measured spectral zones.

recommendations.expectedResult: Improved midrange articulation and subsonic headroom stability ahead of limiting.
recommendations.potentialTradeoffs: Excessive cuts (>3 dB) can hollow out body; kept surgical.

recommendations.proposedCorrection: Apply gentle bus compression with 85 Hz sidechain HPF and slow attack to preserve kick/snare punch.

commands.name: Transient-Safe Bus Comp
commands.rationale: Cohesive bus glue and peak density smoothing ahead of final limiting.

recommendations.expectedResult: Steadier RMS density and ~1–2 dB peak headroom recovery for cleaner limiting.
recommendations.potentialTradeoffs: Too fast an attack or low threshold will flatten drum transients; monitored in QC.

recommendations.characteristic: Loudness calibration (-15.9 -> -14.0 LUFS) & True Peak ceiling protection
recommendations.proposedCorrection: Engage True-Peak calibrated Maximizer with transient emphasis to hit target loudness cleanly.
recommendations.proposedParamsSummary: TRANSPARENT · Target -14 LUFS · Ceiling -1 dBTP · Transients 30%

commands.name: True-Peak Master Finalizer
commands.rationale: Calibrate final integrated loudness and enforce strict True-Peak headroom.

recommendations.expectedResult: Integrated loudness converges near -14.0 LUFS with <= -1.0 dBTP ceiling.
recommendations.potentialTradeoffs: Minimal dynamic range impact within target margin.

strategy.vocalPresence: Unverified; no separated vocal stem measurement
strategy.strategySummary: Constructed 3-stage chain for Streaming objective (-14.0 LUFS / <= -1.0 dBTP).

reasoningPerProcessor.reason: Spectral contour calibration -> Shape tonal contour surgically while clearing subsonic rumble below 28 Hz. (Tradeoff: Excessive cuts (>3 dB) can hollow out body; kept surgical.)

Crest factor 13.5 dB & DR 14.2 dB -> Apply gentle bus compression with 85 Hz sidechain HPF and slow attack to preserve kick/snare punch. (Tradeoff: Too fast an attack or low threshold will flatten drum transients; monitored in QC.)

Loudness calibration (-15.9 -> -14.0 LUFS) & True Peak ceiling protection -> Engage True-Peak calibrated Maximizer with transient emphasis to hit target loudness cleanly. (Tradeoff: Minimal dynamic range impact within target margin.)
